summary: Iteration 2 (tiered pricing, admin panel, payments, imported catalog) tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (catalog 14 top cats, dapur subcats, pagination skip=40 no overlap, q search + price_asc, 6,618 products, /store with 3 branches+hours, invalid token 401, non-admin 403, global reseller pricing 5% + qty tiers 6/12 -> cart unit = base*0.95*0.96, savings & next_tier correct, per-product manual reseller tiers override only reseller, checkout validation 422, midtrans/xendit 503 'belum dikonfigurasi' without clearing cart, COD -> status cod, admin orders filter, status change shipped reflected to owner, invalid status 422). Frontend (390x844): home PGS logo + 'Lihat lebih banyak' 40->80, Kategori sidebar 14 + infinite scroll, login 'Masuk dengan Google' button present, admin login -> Akun admin menu -> dashboard stats, Pesanan Masuk filter COD + detail + Kirim status change, Pengaturan Harga save, Kategori Pelanggan set Reseller, Harga Manual per Produk save; demo reseller: product tier table + unit price changes at qty 6, cart unit price/next-tier hint/savings/'Pesan via WhatsApp' (opens wa.me with order text), checkout Midtrans/Xendit show error without crash, COD -> order detail 'Bayar di Tempat'. All flows PASS; only minor UX/code issues found. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Fonnte notification correctly skipped with warning log. All test settings were RESET (pricing 0/[], demo=langsung, tier_prices cleared on pgs-9957/pgs-9955), test orders cancelled.

minor.issue: Response leaks internal settings field "key":"store" (also GET/PUT /api/admin/pricing returns "key":"pricing"). Exclude it in projection.

'today' start = UTC midnight - 7h. Between 00:00-07:00 WIB the UTC date is still yesterday, so orders_today/revenue_today include the previous WIB day. Compute midnight in Asia/Jakarta tz then convert to UTC.
Stock is not decremented on order creation (product.stock stays unchanged); may oversell if stock matters.

ui_bugs.issue: checkout-error Text is rendered at the very bottom of the ScrollView (below Ringkasan); on 390x844 after tapping 'Bayar Sekarang' with Midtrans/Xendit or empty fields the error is off-screen so user sees nothing happen. Show it near the sticky pay button, scroll to it, or use an Alert/toast.

issues: Qty tier row (Beli ≥ [min] [pct] % [trash]) overflows container at 390px width: the '%' suffix is clipped at the right screen edge. Reduce input widths / use flex:1.

'Hemat harga bertingkat -Rp88.182' is shown between Subtotal (already discounted) and Ongkir, visually implying it is subtracted again although Total = Subtotal + Ongkir. Use label like 'Termasuk hemat' (as checkout does) or show normal subtotal before discount.

Fix qty-tier row overflow on admin pricing screen ('%' clipped) (app/admin/pricing.tsx ~line 80-90)
